# facet contract manifest — GENERATED by tools/gen_contract.py

Every declared word, its type, and the ledger row it came from. A verb
absent here does not exist: calling it is a compile error, never a
silent no-op. What a backend cannot implement is recorded in that
backend's own manifest, not here.

406 declared verbs over 38 controls, plus the
shared band every element carries.

every element carries is written in one place and no generic element
type exists.
